title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
summary: The U.S. has secured majority control of over 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's oil reserves under an unusual agreement with the country's interim president. The deal is expected to help revive Venezuela's economy while significantly strengthening U.S. energy resources in Latin America.
content: Venezuelan interim president says the unusual agreement will help revive her country's economy.

zh.title: 特朗普赞叹美国控制委内瑞拉650亿桶石油的"历史性"交易
zh.summary: 美国根据与该国过渡总统达成的不寻常协议，已获得委内瑞拉超过650亿桶石油储备的多数控制权。该交易预计将帮助恢复委内瑞拉经济，同时显著加强美国在拉丁美洲的能源资源。
